caption: The drawing features a rectangular textile design, predominantly in shades of red and dark brown. At the center, there is a large vase or urn with intricately curved handles and a textured pattern. Perched atop the vase is a bird, detailed with distinct feathers and a long tail. Surrounding the vase and bird is a dense pattern of various large flowers with prominent petals and leaves, which fill the entire background. The edges of the textile are irregular, and the overall pattern appears symmetrical around the central vase and bird. The colors primarily consist of maroon, pink, and brown, with the floral motifs and central figures outlined and shaded to show depth and detail. The drawing is bordered by a wide, plain, light-colored margin, and at the lower left corner, there are small printed or inscribed letters: "JU LOKANO."
title: Printed Cotton
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
